description: This file is a script for analyzing TypeScript source files within a project directory. It detects direct calls to window.open or globalThis.open that are not within allowed call sites and reports violations. It primarily facilitates code quality and security checks related to raw window.open usage.

methods.name: asPropertyAccess
methods.description: Checks if an expression is a property access expression and returns it if so.

methods.name: isRawWindowOpenCall
methods.description: Determines if a call expression is a raw window.open call by checking if it accesses 'window.open' or 'globalThis.open'.
